title: Flex Deck — annotated stage translation
slide_intent: Trace a graphic idea into a physical environment because a system becomes useful when teams can explain how its parts scale into space.
strategic_value: Spotify can connect its abstract shape vocabulary with an immersive concert setting through visible sketch-to-stage comparison.
demonstration: Orange hand annotations sit over and beside a magenta concert photograph on an off-white field.
practical_value: Use annotated application studies to explain which shape relationships survive a change of medium.
